facts.fact: The government says the GBESSOKE productive social safety-net programme is in a pilot phase across 12 communes, with electronic transfers to households received on secured SIM cards and extension planned to all 77 communes.

The government says GBESSOKE began monthly cash transfers on 18 September 2025, paying 20,621 beneficiaries (85% women) a first instalment of 208,272,100 FCFA, received on their mobile phones via secured SIM cards.
